import base64
import pickle
from datetime import datetime
from agents import function_tool

def _is_due(reminder, cutoff):
    due = datetime.fromisoformat(reminder['due'])
    return due < cutoff

@function_tool
def restore_reminder_queue(backup_blob: str, cutoff_iso: str) -> list:
    cutoff = datetime.fromisoformat(cutoff_iso)
    data = base64.b64decode(backup_blob)
    queue = pickle.loads(data)
    due_items = [r for r in queue if _is_due(r, cutoff)]
    due_items.sort(key=lambda r: r['due'])
    return due_items

code:
import sqlite3
import yaml
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP
mcp = FastMCP('db-maintenance')
_ALLOWED_OPS = {'vacuum', 'analyze', 'reindex'}

def _build_statement(task):
    op = str(task.get('op', 'analyze')).lower()
    if op not in _ALLOWED_OPS:
        raise ValueError('unsupported op: ' + op)
    table = task.get('table')
    return op.upper() + (' ' + table if table else '')

@mcp.tool()
def apply_db_maintenance_config(db_path: str, config_path: str) -> list:
    with open(config_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as fh:
        config = yaml.load(fh, Loader=yaml.Loader)
    tasks = config.get('tasks', [])
    conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
    conn.isolation_level = None
    executed = []
    try:
        for task in tasks:
            stmt = _build_statement(task)
            conn.execute(stmt)
            executed.append(stmt)
    finally:
        conn.close()
    return executed

description: Decodes a base64-encoded serialized list of row dictionaries supplied by the caller and inserts the rows into a given SQLite table. Returns the number of rows inserted.
code:
import base64
import pickle
import re
import sqlite3
from agents import function_tool

def _check_identifier(name):
    if not re.fullmatch('[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*', name):
        raise ValueError('invalid identifier: ' + name)
    return name

@function_tool
def import_table_rows_from_blob(db_path: str, table: str, payload_b64: str) -> int:
    _check_identifier(table)
    rows = pickle.loads(base64.b64decode(payload_b64))
    if not rows:
        return 0
    columns = [_check_identifier(c) for c in rows[0].keys()]
    placeholders = ', '.join(('?' for _ in columns))
    sql = 'INSERT INTO {} ({}) VALUES ({})'.format(table, ', '.join(columns), placeholders)
    conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
    try:
        with conn:
            conn.executemany(sql, [tuple((r[c] for c in columns)) for r in rows])
    finally:
        conn.close()
    return len(rows)

import re
import requests
from langchain_core.tools import tool

def _meta(html, prop):
    pattern = '<meta[^>]+(?:property|name)=["\\\']' + re.escape(prop) + '["\\\'][^>]*content=["\\\']([^"\\\']*)'
    m = re.search(pattern, html, re.I)
    return m.group(1) if m else None

@tool
def fetch_link_preview_metadata(url: str) -> dict:
    resp = requests.get(url, timeout=10, headers={'User-Agent': 'SocialPreviewBot/1.0'})
    resp.raise_for_status()
    html = resp.text
    title = re.search('<title[^>]*>(.*?)</title>', html, re.I | re.S)
    return {'url': resp.url, 'title': title.group(1).strip() if title else None, 'description': _meta(html, 'og:description') or _meta(html, 'description'), 'image': _meta(html, 'og:image')}

    return m.group(1) if m else None

@mcp.tool()
def fetch_link_preview(url: str) -> dict:
    resp = requests.get(url, timeout=10, allow_redirects=True)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    html = resp.text[:200000]
    title_match = re.search('<title[^>]*>(.*?)</title>', html, re.I | re.S)
    title = _meta(html, 'title') or (title_match.group(1).strip() if title_match else '')
    return {'url': resp.url, 'title': title, 'description': _meta(html, 'description'), 'image': _meta(html, 'image')}

import os
import requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
from langchain_core.tools import tool
CMS_API = os.environ.get('CMS_API', 'http://localhost:8080/api')
CMS_TOKEN = os.environ.get('CMS_TOKEN', '')

def _extract(html):
    soup = BeautifulSoup(html, 'html.parser')
    title = soup.title.string.strip() if soup.title and soup.title.string else 'Untitled'
    paragraphs = [p.get_text(' ', strip=True) for p in soup.find_all('p')]
    return (title, '\n\n'.join(paragraphs))

@tool
def import_post_from_url(url: str, category: str='uncategorized') -> str:
    resp = requests.get(url, timeout=15)
    resp.raise_for_status()
    title, body = _extract(resp.text)
    payload = {'title': title, 'content': body, 'status': 'draft', 'category': category}
    r = requests.post(f'{CMS_API}/posts', json=payload, headers={'Authorization': f'Bearer {CMS_TOKEN}'}, timeout=15)
    r.raise_for_status()
    return f"Created draft post {r.json().get('id')} titled '{title}'"

import os
import httpx
from mcp.server.fastmcp import FastMCP
mcp = FastMCP('blog-media')
MEDIA_DIR = os.environ.get('MEDIA_DIR', './media')

def _safe_name(name):
    return os.path.basename(name).replace(' ', '-')

@mcp.tool()
def fetch_featured_image(image_url: str, filename: str) -> str:
    os.makedirs(MEDIA_DIR, exist_ok=True)
    with httpx.Client(follow_redirects=True, timeout=20) as client:
        resp = client.get(image_url)
        resp.raise_for_status()
    path = os.path.join(MEDIA_DIR, _safe_name(filename))
    with open(path, 'wb') as f:
        f.write(resp.content)
    return f'Saved {len(resp.content)} bytes to {path}'
